sites.why: Rule 2: this is loushang's generic OpenAI chat-completions protocol adapter, shared by every catalog provider on that protocol (openai_chat_completions.py:148 base_url=resolved.base_url, line 71 model=model.upstream_id or model.id, both resolved from a Model/Endpoint registry entry chosen at runtime, not a literal in this call). The shipped catalog (src/loushang/ai/model/models.json) routes this exact call to baidu-qianfan, deepseek, moonshot, kimi-code, volcano-ark and zai (non-OpenAI hosts) as well as the official OpenAI host, and users can add further arbitrary endpoints via .loushang/models/ (docs/en/getting-started/README.md:47; examples/ai/advanced/custom_catalog.py). Moving this call to Router would break the non-OpenAI/Anthropic configurations it is designed to support.

The catalog routes this protocol to the official OpenAI host, to OpenAI's undocumented chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex ChatGPT-OAuth host ('coding-responses' endpoint, auth/sources/openai_codex.py, marked experimental), and to Alibaba Dashscope / Tencent Hunyuan (non-OpenAI hosts) -- plus any user-added .loushang/models/ endpoint. store is explicitly forced to False (line 147), so Responses state is never used. Rewriting this call to Router would be wrong for the non-OpenAI-host and ChatGPT-OAuth configurations.

sites.why: Rule 2: generic Anthropic Messages protocol adapter (non-streaming branch); base_url (line 434, request.base_url) and model (line 299/323, model.upstream_id or model.id) are resolved at runtime from the Model/Endpoint registry, not literals here. The catalog routes this protocol to the official Anthropic host, to MiniMax (api.minimax.io/anthropic) and to Moonshot's Kimi Code anthropic-compatible endpoint (api.kimi.com/coding), all non-Anthropic hosts, plus any user-added .loushang/models/ endpoint. For MiniMax/Kimi-Code models (budgeted thinking mode) this path sends the 'anthropic-beta' header (interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14 / fine-grained-tool-streaming-2025-05-14 per _anthropic.py apply_beta_headers and models.json kimi-code adapter block), which would also independently trigger rule 5 if rule 2 did not already apply.
